entries.84e4418e69a18032: This regional segment manufactures and sells paints in Japan; revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥159,888 million. In addition to the company's own manufacturing and sales, affiliates such as Kubotaka Paint, Kanpe Hapio and Nihon Kako Toryo manufacture products, and the company purchases some of them for resale. Sales are, in principle, conducted through specialty distributors and sales companies designated by the company, and are carried out by companies including Kansai Paint Hanbai Co., Ltd. Kubotaka Paint Co., Ltd. was merged into Kansai Paint Hanbai Co., Ltd. through an absorption merger effective April 1, 2026.
